value.objection: Long-time buyers say new socks are thinner and wear out faster than the pairs they bought years ago.
value.proof: No proof in the sample removes this. It needs a spec or construction answer (weight, yarn, cushion) and a clear guarantee line on the PDP.

reviews.quote: Bombas quality has deteriorated more and more every year. I have been buying Bombas socks since 2019, and a pair I still have from 2020 is in better condition than some I bought only 2 years ago. Now these are even lower quality than those. Their socks used to be much thicker, softer, and more durable. Bombas used to be the apex of socks for me, but over the last 3-4 years, their quality has continued to go down and they are nothing better than your average sock at this point. Its a bitter sweet farewell for me, I think. But I simply cannot justify spending $15-20 per pair of socks for something that is no longer of high quality.
I feel like the quality of the socks I most recently purchased were not as good as all the socks I have bought in the past

I purchased 4 pairs of socks this year to refresh my bombas collection, two white and two walnut and they are all much lower quality than those purchased last year and before. The seams are weak and the material seems to come apart very easily. I have multiple pairs that I wore weekly prior to these and they have no issues.
